standard.delta_reaudit: The root standard changed during this acceptance branch. S/K/L criteria remain materially compatible, while status vocabulary is now PASS / PASS_WITH_DEBT / BLOCKED / UNTESTED and Module E2E explicitly includes persistence/idempotency/error paths where learner evidence can mutate. This ledger adopts the new vocabulary before merge.

gate_legend.PASS: No known acceptance defect remains for the audited scope and sufficient evidence exists.
gate_legend.PASS_WITH_DEBT: The intended journey is semantically correct and usable; only named non-blocking debt remains.
gate_legend.BLOCKED: A known defect changes learning semantics, prevents the intended action, leaks/protects evidence incorrectly, manufactures debt/mastery, loses evidence, or mutates the wrong learner object.
gate_legend.UNTESTED: Evidence is not yet sufficient to judge. This is not failure and cannot be described as PASS.

global_rules: Build/CI/page existence/content volume/CURRENT labels/question inventory/simulated QA are evidence only, never acceptance substitutes.
Shared semantic rule != private learner strategy/configuration.
Diagnosis != repair; repair != mastery; same-item correction is repair evidence only.
Later fresh transfer outranks remembered local correction when mastery/closure claims require transfer.
U is path-scoped and requires real learner use.
